logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

Supporting illustration for the WO-01 pump-module verification memo. Render a clean two-panel analytical chart, no decorative imagery. Left panel: horizontal bars of measured acceptance-run energy per candidate on the shared duty basis — P2 12 kWh (highlighted green, labeled leader), P3 52, P1 56, P4 58 kWh — with a dashed vertical reference at the 12 kWh leader line and per-bar gap annotations (+40, +44, +46 kWh vs P2). Right panel: two small gate charts. Chart 1: quality indices 84/97/80/81 as bars against a dashed floor line at 80, noting P3 sits exactly on the floor. Chart 2: raw defect counts 4/1/3/0 as bars against a dashed ceiling line at 5, noting P1 has one defect of headroom and P4 has zero defects. Neutral engineering palette (slate blue bars, green highlight for P2, red dashed limit lines), sans-serif labels, clear axis ticks, no JavaScript. Purpose: show the verifier-recomputed ranking, the magnitude of the P2 energy advantage, and that eligibility gates do not separate the field.
